audit.summary: Four confirmed Major findings concern metric construction/descent, the formal zero-Lee theorem domain, the principal-torsor image criterion and the negative deformation class inference. Eight bounded Minor corrections remain; intended strict conclusions and repaired existence/openness results are not refuted.
limitations: The positive-line metric and its finite arithmetic descent fail — Counterevidence: Reciprocal norm or norm on negative dual supplies a valid metric; a NEW metric formed from average Lee form is positive and Vaisman. Neither construction counterexample disproves existence or headline strict Vaisman conclusions.

Printed Vaisman definition includes the excluded zero-Lee case — Counterevidence: Introduction explicitly concerns non-Kähler geometry; normalization norm(theta)=1 and one-dimensional Lee group show strict convention intended. n>1 is explicitly present and is not a finding.

Proper locally free actions need compatible effective slice isotropy — Counterevidence: Actual Lee group is an effective abelian subgroup of AutX and has faithful slice isotropy; its intended application avoids this counterexample.
Coarse-to-orbifold cohomology comparison fails over arbitrary fields — Counterevidence: Real/complex characteristic0 cohomology applications are unaffected.

The anti-Lee vector need not itself be an integral lattice vector — Counterevidence: Only positive real proportionality to a primitive integral direction is needed and is compatible with the next proof step.

Flat principal elliptic monodromy is incorrectly typed as group automorphisms — Counterevidence: Exact exponential sheaf sequences prove the desired image criterion directly: zero-Chern P0 comes fromu inH1(O), whose image inH1(O*) maps toP0.
Beltrami projection formula has the wrong fixed-bundle type — Counterevidence: The intended graph distribution and Kuranishi construction work with standard fixed-bundle Beltrami coordinates.
A disconnected compact subgroup need not act trivially on tangent cohomology — Counterevidence: H0 is connected compact with the same dimension; finalH=Aut0 clause is already connected.

Negative Ricci target and subsequent projection have inconsistent signs — Counterevidence: Eq22 already uses negativeRicci. Full norm calculation reconstructed: Dnorm²=gnorm²-hnorm²; Chern correction and projection subtract halfgnorm²each, leaving -hnorm² and xi0=0.

Continuity of fiberwise forms does not force Chern class equality — Counterevidence: A metric on the relative orbifold canonical bundle supplies forms in the exact Chern class; positivity is open. No counterexample to stability is claimed.
Properly elliptic Vaisman surfaces need not have coarse base genus greater than one — Counterevidence: Afterfiniteorbifolduniformizingcover onehasbasegenus>1; negative Bott-Chern signremainscorrect.
Punctured hypersurface cone is O(-1), not O(-d) — Counterevidence: CorrectedO(-1)negative andadjunctiond=sumw unchanged; weightedexamplesremainvalid.

repair.content:
Use reciprocal positive-line potential with consistent normalization. Define new -dJtheta_F+theta_F wedge Jtheta_F, prove positivity from averaged transverse curvature/common vertical Lee field, and do not equate it with arithmetic metric mean.

Require theta nonzero or explicitly define strict non-Kähler Vaisman throughout.

Require faithful local slice isotropy or explicitly allow ineffective orbifolds retaining generic isotropy. Do not confuse global effectiveness with slice effectiveness for a general H.

Assume characteristic0 or invert every isotropy order.

Replace integral by positive real multiple of primitive lattice vector, or impose an explicit period normalization.

Use the common H1(O) element in the commuting exponential sequences; if discussing monodromy, use translationsG and justify any lift.

Invert the old(0,1)projection on new(0,1), then take old(1,0). Correct graph is newT0,1=(1+phi)oldT0,1; examplephi=mu partial.

Run the proof withH0; holomorphic functions on compact connected H0 are constant.

Seteta in-2pi cBC andrho=-eta; correct covariant contraction sign; retain squarednorm argument. Do not claim a nonzero global holomorphic horizontalxi0 under negative hypotheses.

Use fiberwise Chern curvature of an extended positive Hermitian metric on the relative orbifold canonical bundle.

Require positiveorbifoldcanonicaldegree; onlydescribe genus>1afterfinitecover.

ReplaceO(-d)byO(-1); retainadjunctiondegree.
